I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

There have been some spectacular science fiction movies that completely flopped at the box office. They all feature stunning visuals, compelling stories and great characters but were either failed by their marketing teams or just couldn't get enough butts in seats on their release. Several have become cult classics while others have languished in obscurity but you can stream them all at home right now.
